title: Polynomial-time promise reduction
statement: Given Boolean-string languages $Y,N,Y',N'$, a polynomial-time promise reduction from $(Y,N)$ to $(Y',N')$ is a polynomial-time computable function on Boolean strings that maps every string in $Y$ into $Y'$ and every string in $N$ into $N'$.
